question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of F. Only B sits to the right of D. Only three people sit between D and A. E sits at some place to the left of G but at some place to the right of C. How many people sit to the right of F?
solution: Given: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing n orth. 1) Only three people sit to the left of F. 2) Only B sits to the right of D. 3) Only three people sit between D and A.
